events.name: InternationalTransferInitiated
events.trigger: PER-002 submits a valid international transfer instruction in PH-029. SCA is completed. SVC-010 creates ENT-026 (InternationalTransfer, status = pending_compliance) and immediately publishes this event. The event carries all beneficiary details, amount, currency, purpose code, and charges type required for concurrent compliance checks.

payload_schema.beneficiary_name: string — beneficiary legal name (FATF travel rule originator obligation)
payload_schema.amount: number (decimal, 2 dp) — transfer amount in transfer currency

consumers.action: Triggers concurrent sanctions screening of beneficiary (name, IBAN, BIC) and correspondent chain BICs. Publishes TransferSanctionsScreened (EVT-051).
Triggers corporate wire fraud scoring using ML model. Publishes TransferFraudScored (EVT-052).
Creates immutable audit log entry for transfer initiation. FATF travel rule originator data logged at initiation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international. Strictly ordered within a transfer's event sequence.
events.retention: 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111; FATF travel rule and MLR 2017 Regulation 40)

events.name: FXQuoteProvided
events.trigger: SVC-010 obtains an FX rate from the internal FX pricing engine in PH-030 for a cross-currency international transfer. Published when a new FXQuotation (ENT-027) is created, including on quote refresh after lapse. Not published for GBP-denominated transfers (PH-030 skipped).

payload_schema.sell_currency: string (ISO 4217) — always GBP for UK corporate transfers
payload_schema.quoted_gbp_equivalent: number (decimal, 2 dp) — GBP cost at this rate

consumers.action: Renders the FX rate, GBP equivalent, and acceptance countdown timer on the corporate portal. Notifies PER-002 to accept or decline.
Logs FX quote details for regulatory audit trail (FX transparency and Consumer Duty evidence).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.

events.name: TransferSanctionsScreened
events.trigger: SVC-051 completes concurrent sanctions screening of all entities in the international transfer (beneficiary name/IBAN/BIC and each correspondent BIC) after consuming InternationalTransferInitiated (EVT-049). Published with a consolidated outcome after all entity screens complete. Cross-capability event: published by CAP-005, consumed by CAP-003.

payload_schema.screening_result_id: string (UUID v4) — SVC-103 audit log entry reference
payload_schema.outcome: string enum (clear | hit | error) — consolidated across all screened entities
payload_schema.entities_screened: integer — count of entities screened (1 beneficiary + N correspondents)
payload_schema.hit_entity_count: integer — number of entities with a sanctions match (0 if outcome = clear)

events.payload_omissions: Hit entity names and IBAN/BIC details are not included in the event payload — tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A). Details available only via SVC-103 audit log with MLRO access.

consumers.action: Evaluates outcome. If hit: sets InternationalTransfer.status = sanctions_blocked; publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057); alerts MLRO. If clear: records screening_result_id; waits for EVT-052 (correlation map on transfer_id).
Creates immutable OFSI-compliant sanctions screening decision record. Required for OFSI audit programme and GOV-005-R02.
Archives sanctions screening outcome. OFSI requires screening records retained for minimum 5 years.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic compliance.sanctions.
events.retention: 5 years minimum (OFSI obligation); 7 years where hit detected

events.name: TransferFraudScored
events.trigger: SVC-013 completes corporate wire fraud scoring after consuming InternationalTransferInitiated (EVT-049). Published with risk_score, risk_level, and model metadata. Cross-capability event: published by CAP-004, consumed by CAP-003.

payload_schema.fraud_score_id: string (UUID v4) — internal SVC-013 score record identifier
payload_schema.risk_score: number (0.0–1.0, 4 dp) — ML model output probability of fraud
payload_schema.model_version: string — ML model version identifier for audit and reproducibility
payload_schema.top_risk_features: array<string> — top 3 contributing feature names (not values — privacy-preserving)

consumers.action: Evaluates risk_level. If block: sets InternationalTransfer.status = fraud_blocked; publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057). If non-block: records fraud_score_id; waits for EVT-051 (correlation map on transfer_id).
Logs fraud score and risk level. Required for Consumer Duty AI/ML decision audit trail and Failure to Prevent Fraud evidence (GOV-005-R03).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic fraud.scores.
events.retention: 7 years (FCA Consumer Duty; Failure to Prevent Fraud corporate liability evidence)

events.name: TransferCleared
events.trigger: SVC-010 has received both TransferSanctionsScreened (EVT-051, outcome = clear) and TransferFraudScored (EVT-052, risk_level != block), and has assembled the SWIFT pacs.008 message in PH-032. Published to signal that the transfer is cleared for SWIFT submission. Analogous to PaymentCleared (EVT-182) in JRN-002.

payload_schema.gbp_equivalent: number (decimal, 2 dp) — final GBP debit amount
payload_schema.gpi_uetr: string (UUID v4) — SWIFT gpi Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference

consumers.action: Triggers PH-033 SWIFT submission. SVC-010 consumes its own event as the trigger to proceed (event-driven internal state machine).
Records transfer clearance with gpi_uetr for end-to-end SWIFT gpi audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.

events.name: SWIFTMessageSent
events.trigger: SVC-010 successfully submits the pacs.008 message to the SWIFT network via SAA Cloud in PH-033. SWIFTMessage.sent_timestamp is set. This event signals that the transfer has left the bank's systems and is in transit in the SWIFT network. It also triggers the BusinessAccount debit at SVC-005 (CAP-002) via async consumption.

payload_schema.business_account_id: string (UUID v4) — for SVC-005 debit instruction
payload_schema.first_correspondent_bic: string (ISO 9362 BIC) — first hop in correspondent chain

consumers.action: Debits BusinessAccount.balance by gbp_equivalent. Cross-capability async consumption. Idempotent on transfer_id — duplicate events do not result in duplicate debits. Publishes intra-CAP-002 BusinessAccountDebited event.
Records SWIFT submission timestamp for SWIFT gpi SLA tracking and regulatory audit.
Archives SWIFT message sent event. FATF travel rule and MLR 2017 audit obligation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.
events.retention: 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111; FATF travel rule)

events.name: CorrespondentAcknowledged
events.trigger: SVC-010 receives a SWIFT gpi ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess) acknowledgement from the first correspondent bank in the chain in PH-033. SWIFTMessage.ack_timestamp is set. Signals that the correspondent has accepted and is processing the pacs.008.

payload_schema.accepting_correspondent_bic: string (ISO 9362 BIC) — BIC of the acknowledging correspondent
payload_schema.gpi_status: string — SWIFT gpi status code at acknowledgement (ACSP)

consumers.action: Updates transfer tracker in corporate portal to 'Processing at correspondent bank'. Notifies customer via portal status update.
Records correspondent acknowledgement timestamp for SWIFT gpi SLA monitoring.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.

events.name: TransferCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-010 receives the SWIFT gpi ACCC (AcceptedCreditSettlementCompleted) status for the transfer's UETR — confirming that the beneficiary bank has credited the beneficiary's account. InternationalTransfer.status is set to completed in PH-034.

consumers.action: Dispatches push notification and email confirmation to PER-002 confirming transfer completion. Includes UETR and SWIFT reference for customer records.
Creates immutable completion record. FATF travel rule end-to-end completion evidence.
Archives completed transfer event. MLR 2017 Regulation 40 five-year retention; FATF travel rule retention.

Consumes TransferCompleted for ongoing transaction monitoring (GOV-005-R01). Updates the BusinessCustomer's transaction monitoring profile with the completed international transfer value and destination jurisdiction.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international. Terminal event for the transfer — no further events published for this transfer_id after TransferCompleted.
events.retention: 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111; FATF travel rule; MLR 2017)

events.name: TransferFailed
events.trigger: Published by SVC-010 when the international transfer fails at any stage. Failure reasons include: sanctions block (EVT-051 outcome = hit); fraud block (EVT-052 risk_level = block); compliance check timeout; correspondent rejection (SWIFT pacs.002 RJCT); account debit failure. This is the terminal failure event — InternationalTransfer.status is set to a terminal failed state.
events.journey_phase: PH-031 or PH-033 (depending on failure reason)

payload_schema.failure_reason: string enum (sanctions_block | fraud_block | compliance_timeout | correspondent_rejection | insufficient_funds | account_debit_failure | internal_error)
payload_schema.failure_reason_code: string — ISO 20022 reason code for correspondent rejections (e.g. AC01, NARR); null for internal failures
payload_schema.gpi_uetr: string (UUID v4) — set if failure occurs after UETR assignment; null otherwise

events.payload_omissions: For sanctions_block failures: the specific matched entity name/IBAN/BIC is NOT included in the payload (tipping-off prohibition, POCA 2002 s333A). Only the screening_result_id is included as a reference to the SVC-103 audit log entry accessible to MLRO only.

consumers.action: Dispatches customer decline notification. For sanctions_block and fraud_block: generic text only — 'We are unable to process this transfer.' No specific reason disclosed to customer. For correspondent_rejection: standardised reason text derived from ISO 20022 reason code.
For failure_reason = sanctions_block: triggers MLRO alert workflow. SVC-014 creates an investigation record. OFSI notification assessed within 14 days.
Creates immutable failure audit record with full failure context. Required for PSR dispute resolution and regulatory audit.
Archives failure event for compliance retention. Sanctions blocks retained 5–7 years per GOV-005-R02.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international. Terminal event — no further events expected for this transfer_id after TransferFailed.
events.retention: 7 years for all failure types; 5 years minimum for sanctions_block (OFSI) extendable to 7 years
